summary: A playable 1v1 RTS slice on a hand-built symmetric map: two asymmetric factions, economy/supply/tech/fog of war, a fog-obeying utility AI with three levels, tutorial, replays with hash verification and post-game stats.
notes: Procedural assets only. HUD is vanilla DOM (not React); navigation runs on the main thread (no workers); WebGPU path, occlusion fade, LODs and online play are not implemented. Performance on a real GPU is unverified (only software-rendered headless Edge was available). Restarted from an empty workspace after the first attempt died on a provider error. This build is from the second, uninterrupted run.
